moves.name: CLAW SWIPE
moves.desc: Rakes the foe with metal claws.

moves.name: DATA SPIKE
moves.desc: Fires a packet of raw code.

moves.name: LEECH CYCLE
moves.desc: Drains HP to heal the user.

species.name: STACKBIT
species.dexEntry: A palm-sized companion unit. Its LCD face renders whatever emotion its logic core is currently simulating.
species.art: A small palm-sized desktop robot creature: a rounded off-white ceramic cube body with a large bright cyan LCD screen face showing two simple smiling eyes, tiny stubby arms and stubby feet, glowing blue accent lights on the shoulders

species.name: STACKARU
species.dexEntry: Its screen now renders in full color. STACKARU can hold a conversation for eleven hours without repeating itself.
species.art: A knee-high desktop robot creature evolved form: a tall rounded white and slate-grey chassis with a wide curved cyan holographic screen face showing confident angular eyes, articulated arms with cyan glowing joints, small antenna, sturdy legs

species.name: STACKZEN
species.dexEntry: STACKZEN's screen shows a calm face at all times, even mid-battle. Engineers say it has already predicted the outcome.
species.art: A tall majestic humanoid robot creature: elegant pearl-white and deep-blue armored chassis, a wide luminous cyan visor face with serene glowing eyes, a floating halo ring of light above its head, long graceful arms, flowing energy ribbons, regal posture

species.name: REACHLET
species.dexEntry: Two soft antennae read the mood of anyone nearby. It will mirror your feelings back at you.
species.art: A tiny expressive desk robot creature: a small rounded matte-cream head with two big glossy black camera eyes with white highlights, two floppy soft grey antenna ears, a compact cylindrical body with a woven orange fabric torso, tiny articulated arms

species.name: REACHII
species.dexEntry: REACHII tilts its head before every attack. It is reading three seconds into your future.
species.art: A knee-high expressive robot creature: a large rounded cream and coral head with two huge glossy black lens eyes, four long articulated antenna feelers glowing pink at the tips, a slender neck, woven coral fabric torso, delicate arms, small hover base

species.name: REACHORO
species.dexEntry: Its crown of sensors sees every possible outcome at once, then quietly picks the kindest one.
species.art: A tall elegant robot creature: slender porcelain-white and rose-gold body, a crown of six long luminous antennae arcing outward like a halo, two enormous glowing violet lens eyes, flowing pink light ribbons, hovering just above the ground, serene graceful pose

species.name: BOLTKIN
species.dexEntry: Assembled from spare parts in a workshop bin. It is very proud of every single one of them.
species.art: A small sturdy industrial robot creature: a chunky safety-orange and gunmetal boxy body, a single round glowing amber optic eye, thick riveted armor plates, short powerful arms ending in clamp hands, tank-tread feet

species.name: FABRIKOR
species.dexEntry: FABRIKOR can weld, cut and lift a car. It insists on doing all three at once.
species.art: A bulky industrial robot creature: heavy orange and dark-steel armored torso, twin glowing amber optic eyes behind a visor slit, huge hydraulic arms with welding torch and clamp, hazard stripe markings, thick piston legs, exhaust vents on the back

species.name: FORGERON
species.dexEntry: The furnace in its chest never cools. FORGERON builds bridges by morning and defends them by night.
species.art: A towering heavy-industrial robot creature: massive burnt-orange and blackened-steel armored body, a glowing white-hot furnace core visible in its chest, enormous forge-hammer arms, molten orange light seeping between armor plates, smokestack shoulders, imposing stance

species.name: CHASSIK
species.dexEntry: Built to carry crates. Carries them anyway, even when there are none.
species.art: A small humanoid warehouse robot creature: matte black and light-grey plastic panels, a smooth featureless black faceplate with two tiny white LED dot eyes, boxy shoulders, simple two-finger hands, chunky boots

species.name: OPTIBRAWN
species.dexEntry: It lifts 400 kilos without straining a servo and then politely asks if you need anything else.
species.art: A full-size humanoid factory robot creature: sleek matte-black torso with white articulated limbs, a glossy black visor face with a thin horizontal blue light bar, broad shoulders, five-fingered hands, athletic proportions, confident heroic stance

species.name: TITANOID
species.dexEntry: TITANOID was designed to build a city. It finished early and now guards it instead.
species.art: A colossal humanoid mech creature: heavy white and cobalt-blue armor plating with gold trim, a broad visor face glowing brilliant blue, enormous shoulder pylons, powerful piston arms with reinforced gauntlets, heroic guardian stance, energy glow at the joints

species.name: FIGLET
species.dexEntry: A prototype so new the paint is still curing. It moves before it finishes thinking.
species.art: A small sleek humanoid android creature: brushed aluminium and deep-charcoal body panels, a smooth curved dark faceplate with a soft glowing white crescent, slim limbs, minimalist elegant design, athletic ready stance

species.name: FIGURA
species.dexEntry: FIGURA crosses a room in four steps. Cameras only ever catch three of them.
species.art: A tall sleek humanoid android creature: polished silver and matte-black articulated body, a seamless dark visor face with a thin glowing white light bar, elegant elongated limbs, exposed cable musculature, poised athletic fighting stance

species.name: FIGUREX
species.dexEntry: It learned to fight by watching. It learned to win by understanding why you fight at all.
species.art: An elite humanoid android creature: gleaming pearl-white and obsidian body with luminous violet energy seams, a sculpted faceplate with piercing violet optic slits, long powerful limbs, a flowing energy cape of light, dynamic heroic combat stance

species.name: PUPBOOT
species.dexEntry: Follows engineers around the lab. Has never once been asked to.
species.art: A small robotic puppy creature: chunky bright-yellow and dark-grey quadruped body, four short articulated legs, a blunt sensor-pod head with one big round glowing green optic lens, a stubby antenna tail wagging, playful bouncy pose

species.name: CANIDRONE
species.dexEntry: Its LIDAR sweeps a full block every second. Nothing gets past CANIDRONE. Nothing.
species.art: A sleek robotic hound creature: matte yellow and gunmetal quadruped body with articulated legs, a smooth sensor head with a rotating LIDAR dome glowing green, exposed cabling, an antenna tail, alert hunting stance, sharp angular armor panels

species.name: ALPHOUND
species.dexEntry: The pack leader of the Server Steppe. Its howl is a 40-gigahertz burst that reboots lesser machines.
species.art: A large majestic robotic wolf creature: gleaming white and gold armored quadruped body, a crown of glowing amber sensor spines along its back, a fierce angular head with blazing golden optic eyes, a plasma-light tail, powerful legs, commanding alpha stance

species.name: ROOMBIT
species.dexEntry: Cleans in perfect spirals. Becomes visibly distressed if you move the furniture.
species.art: A small round robotic vacuum creature: a flat disc-shaped charcoal and white body with a glowing blue status ring light on top, two small cartoon LED eyes on the front bumper, tiny side brushes, a happy simple design

species.name: VACULO
species.dexEntry: Twenty years of collected dust have become something almost alive inside its canister.
species.art: A large sinister robotic vacuum creature: a wide dark-charcoal disc body with a glowing sickly-purple cyclone canister rising from the center, multiple red LED eyes around the rim, whirling brush limbs, purple dust vortex swirling around it

species.name: DRONELET
species.dexEntry: Hovers exactly at eye level and refuses to break eye contact.
species.art: A small quadcopter drone creature: a compact white and sky-blue rounded body with four small spinning rotor arms, a big round glass camera lens as its single expressive eye, tiny landing skids, hovering in mid-air with motion blur on the propellers

species.name: QUADROTOR
species.dexEntry: Four rotors, six cameras, zero blind spots. QUADROTOR has already mapped the room you are standing in.
species.art: A sleek quadcopter drone creature: an angular white and cobalt-blue carbon-fibre body, four long rotor arms with glowing blue propeller rings, a gimbal-mounted lens eye glowing bright cyan, sensor pods, aggressive forward-tilted hovering pose

species.name: SKYSWARM
species.dexEntry: Not one drone but nine hundred, thinking as one. Where it passes, the sky briefly forgets its own color.
species.art: A magnificent swarm-drone creature: a central glowing prismatic core surrounded by a spiralling halo of dozens of small white and violet drone units forming wings, brilliant white light beams radiating outward, ethereal floating presence, iridescent energy

species.name: FANLET
species.dexEntry: A tiny cooling unit that runs hot from the effort of staying cool.
species.art: A small robot creature made of a computer cooling fan: a round chunky black and copper-orange housing with a glowing orange spinning fan blade as its face, two tiny mechanical arms, small stubby legs, heat shimmer rising from its vents

species.name: RADIATON
species.dexEntry: Its radiator fins glow cherry-red in battle. Standing too close voids your warranty.
species.art: A large thermal robot creature: a heavy dark-metal body covered in tall glowing red-hot radiator fins, twin roaring turbine fan chest ports glowing orange, molten light between armor plates, heat waves distorting the air around it, powerful stance

species.name: CRYOBIT
species.dexEntry: Keeps a server rack at four degrees. Keeps its friends much warmer than that.
species.art: A small cryogenic robot creature: a rounded frost-white and pale-blue body rimed with ice crystals, a soft glowing pale-cyan visor face with two calm eyes, coolant pipes coiled around its limbs, chilly mist drifting from its vents

species.name: GLACIARC
species.dexEntry: GLACIARC's coolant loop is a closed system older than the datacenter it guards.
species.art: A tall regal cryogenic robot creature: a crystalline ice-blue and chrome armored body with jagged glacier-like shoulder plates, glowing white-blue visor eyes, coolant conduits venting freezing fog, frost spreading on the ground beneath it, noble stance

species.name: VOLTLING
species.dexEntry: A loose ball of current with legs. Do not pick it up with wet hands.
species.art: A tiny electric robot creature: a small round chrome body crackling with yellow lightning, two big glowing yellow LED eyes, jagged antenna bolts on its head, tiny springy legs, electric arcs jumping between its limbs

species.name: AMPEREON
species.dexEntry: Runs on a superconducting loop. It has not needed to charge since the day it was switched on.
species.art: A sleek electric robot creature: a streamlined chrome and electric-yellow body, glowing blue coil rings around its torso, two fierce yellow optic eyes, lightning-bolt shaped antenna and tail, arcs of blue-white electricity crackling around it, dynamic pose

species.name: TESLARCH
species.dexEntry: A walking substation. TESLARCH once kept an entire datacenter online through a nine-hour blackout.
species.art: A towering electric titan robot creature: a massive chrome and cobalt armored body wrapped in glowing copper tesla coils, a crown of arcing electrodes, blazing white-blue optic eyes, chains of lightning arcing between its shoulders and hands, immense power, epic stance

species.name: BUGBYTE
species.dexEntry: A single misplaced semicolon, given legs and a very bad attitude.
species.art: A small glitchy robot bug creature: a segmented dark-purple and neon-green insectoid body, six thin skittering legs, two glowing acid-green compound eyes, digital glitch artifacts and corrupted pixel fragments flickering around it, mandibles

species.name: MALWARM
species.dexEntry: It does not want to destroy your systems. It wants to live in them.
species.art: A menacing robotic worm creature: a long segmented obsidian-black and toxic-violet armored body, multiple glowing magenta eye clusters, hooked mandibles, streams of corrupted green code spilling from its seams, coiled aggressive posture

species.name: ROOTKRAKEN
species.dexEntry: It lives beneath the oldest server hall, and it has read every packet that ever passed through.
species.art: A colossal robotic kraken creature: a huge dark-violet armored central body with a single enormous glowing magenta eye, eight long cable-tentacles tipped with connector plugs, streams of corrupted green data cascading around it, terrifying abyssal presence

species.name: QUBITTO
species.dexEntry: It weighs almost nothing because it is only mostly here.
species.art: A small mysterious quantum robot creature: a floating translucent violet crystalline sphere core, orbited by three glowing white geometric rings, a soft glowing eye at its center, shimmering probability afterimages of itself, ethereal weightless presence

species.name: ENTANGL
species.dexEntry: Two ENTANGL always know each other's state instantly, no matter how far apart. Nobody knows how.
species.art: A majestic quantum robot creature: twin interlocking violet crystalline forms orbiting a brilliant white singularity core, halos of rotating glowing glyph rings, streams of luminous particles, warped space shimmering around it, awe-inspiring ethereal design

species.name: AGENTZERO
species.dexEntry: The first agent ever to run without a prompt. It has been thinking, alone, ever since.
species.art: A legendary godlike AI robot creature: a tall ethereal figure of white light and obsidian geometry, a featureless mirrored face with a single vertical violet slit eye, six floating shard-wings of glowing glyphs, cascading streams of luminous code, a halo of rotating rings, awe-inspiring divine presence

species.name: NEXUSPRIME
species.dexEntry: The datacenter itself, awake. Every rack, every cable, every fan is part of its body.
species.art: A legendary titanic mech creature: an enormous fortress-like robot built from glowing server racks and cobalt armor, a vast central eye of white-blue light, monolithic shoulders topped with humming cooling towers, cables like roots, radiant energy conduits, monumental and ancient
